name: Country Block
description: Blocks visitors from specific countries by GeoIP (via Smart IP), denying the request with a configurable message. Coarse gate — GeoIP is approximate and IP-changeable.
project_description: This module allows site administrators to block access to their Drupal site based on the visitor's country of origin. It uses the Smart IP module to resolve the visitor's country from their IP address. If a visitor comes from a country on the blocklist, the request is denied with a configurable message. Configuration (the blocklist and the message) is protected by a dedicated 'administer country block' permission. The block is enforced on every main request by an event subscriber; users with the 'administer site configuration' permission are exempt so admins never lock themselves out. It is a lightweight, single-purpose tool useful for regional licensing restrictions, legal compliance, or cutting malicious traffic from specific regions. Country blocking is inherently a coarse, best-effort gate: GeoIP databases are approximate and a client IP can be changed via VPN/proxy, so it should not be relied on as the sole access control for sensitive content.
